page: Microsoft Azure D128as_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dasv7 family, powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 128 vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 512 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach external high-performance disk options.

In benchmark testing, the D128as_v7 delivers top-tier performance across compute, memory, and specialized workloads. Its multi-core CPU performance ranks in the top 10% via stress-ng, supported by high memory bandwidth of up to 12,238.78 GB/sec for cached reads and 386.84 GB/sec for uncached reads. The server demonstrates exceptional processing capabilities in software compilation, ray tracing, and database operations. It also exhibits strong performance in large language model inference, achieving 331.25 tokens per second for prompt processing on medium 7B models.

The absence of bundled local storage represents a key architectural tradeoff, requiring reliance on network-attached Premium Storage for data persistence. However, this configuration optimizes resource density and cost efficiency by avoiding charges for unused local disks. The high core count and memory capacity make this server highly suitable for demanding multi-threaded workloads, including large-scale web serving, database operations, software compilation pipelines, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
